Title: New Azure SDKs for Azure Storage and Key Vault are now available

Body.Content:
Today, we’re pleased to announce the general availability of libraries across.NET, Java, JavaScript, and Python for:

  • Storage Blobs version 12.0.0
  • Storage Queues 12.0.0
  • Key Vault Keys 4.0.0
  • Vault Secrets 4.0.0

These libraries make it faster for you to get your job done.

They have been redesigned with your feedback in mind with a focus making the APIs easier to learn and use. Some common code patterns have been built as a convenience meaning fewer lines of code to maintain and fewer concepts to understand while at the same time the libraries retain a rich API set so you can accomplish even advanced scenarios. You can learn a pattern in one library and expect to see it in others and we have reduced the number of dependencies so that you will be able to upgrade projects using multiple libraries together with confidence they aren’t breaking each other. Finally, the designs of these libraries have been tweaked so that you should feel at home regardless of whether you write code in Python, Java, JavaScript, or .NET.

 

We work in the open and your feedback will shape the next changes we make so please file bugs on github at the appropriate language repository.

  • .NET
  • Java
  • JavaScript and TypeScript
  • Python

For more updates or to provide feedback, make sure to follow us on Twitter at @AzureSdk.
